p1: I am Katerina Gerasimovska, founder and owner of Kingdom of Snowstorm, an FCI-registered Bichon Frisé kennel based in Skopje, North Macedonia.
p2: The story of Kingdom of Snowstorm began in 2016, with a little white Bichon Frisé named Hannah who came into my life and changed it in a way I could have never imagined. She was not only my first Bichon — she was the beginning of a beautiful connection with this wonderful breed and the reason a simple love for one little dog slowly became a lifelong journey.
p3: Today, at 10 years old, Hannah still holds a very special place in my heart. She is the first page of the story I continue to write, the one who brought me into the world of Bichon Frisé and inspired everything that came after her.
p4: With time, Hannah’s story continued through her daughter Galla, and later through Galla’s daughter Darla. Through them, the story that began with one little Bichon became a part of something much bigger, carrying the same love from one generation to the next.
p5: As Kingdom of Snowstorm continued to grow, I felt that a new chapter was ready to begin. This year, that chapter brought Oslo into our family — Petit Ami’s Take on Me, from the respected Petit Ami kennel in Oslo, Norway. His arrival became part of the ongoing story of my kennel and the future I continue to build with my dogs.
quote: The name Kingdom of Snowstorm was born from the special world I share with my Bichons. They are my little kingdom — the ones who made this name come to life. Like a snowstorm, they bring movement, energy, and an unforgettable feeling to every day.
